task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Qiskit program that prepares the 4-qubit W state exactly (using controlled rotations) and verifies it by printing the statevector amplitudes of the basis states with a single 1. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
